# Overview

- A guide for creating lecture slides for APHS 20203, Epidemiology and Biostatisics.
- Clean this up later. For now, just get it operational.


# Python Setup

1. From the `aphs20203` repository root, run `sh _ai/tools/shell/setup_python.sh` once.
2. Select `aphs20203/.venv/bin/python` as the Python interpreter in Positron.

**Notes**
- Quarto must also be on `PATH`. 
- The course [README](../README.md#python-setup) owns environment setup and course build instructions; KWB retains the shared scripts and general conversion guide.

```{python}
#| eval: false

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

kwb_root = Path("/Users/bradcannell/Desktop/Git/knowledge-workbench")
course_root = Path("/Users/bradcannell/Desktop/Git/Academia/Teaching/aphs20203")
lecture_root = course_root / "Lecture Slides"

# Match the interpreter used by the course's Quarto hooks so manual chunks
# have the same QR, PDF, and conversion dependencies as preview and builds.
if Path(sys.prefix).resolve() != (course_root / ".venv").resolve():
    raise RuntimeError("Select aphs20203/.venv/bin/python in Positron, then restart the Python session.")

# Import the canonical shared tools from KWB without relying on its Python
# environment or creating a second copy of the presentation scripts.
script_root = kwb_root / "_presentations/scripts"
if str(script_root) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(script_root))

from presentation_convert import presentation_pptx_to_quarto
```


# Create a Draft Quarto Document from an Existing PowerPoint

- Select the source and a new deck folder. 
- The converter creates the `.qmd`, images, and local styles. Quarto generates the title slide from `title` and `subtitle` using the course theme.
- Set `skip_first_slide=True` when the PowerPoint starts with a cover. Its content is retained in the first content slide's speaker notes.
- It references the course's shared theme and logo, and includes slide numbering, chalkboard, and link-preview settings.
- A template copy is unnecessary for conversion.
- The output folder must be new or empty.

```{python}
#| eval: false

source = '/Users/bradcannell/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/2026/APHS 20203 W5-Aossication and Causality.pptx'
output_qmd = lecture_root / "Module 05 - Association and Causality/Association and Causality/Association and Causality.qmd"
print(f"Source: {source}\nDraft: {output_qmd}")

conversion = presentation_pptx_to_quarto(
    source=source,
    output_qmd=output_qmd,
    title="Association and Causality",
    subtitle="APHS 20203 • Epidemiology & Biostatistics",
    skip_first_slide=True,
    project_root=lecture_root,
    shared_theme=lecture_root / "_theme/tcu.scss",
    logo=lecture_root / "assets/tcu-logo-purple.svg",
)
print(f"Draft: {conversion['qmd']}\nSlides: {conversion['slides']}")
```


# Review and Refine the Draft

1. Compare the draft with the PowerPoint and address any `REVIEW` comments for unsupported content or uncertain formatting. Edit the `.qmd` directly, one slide or section at a time.
2. Adjust layout and image alt text as needed. Reuse `_theme/tcu.scss`; keep deck-specific styles in `custom.scss`.
3. Preview the deck and inspect the rendered slides for missing content, clipping, and image or table problems. Use the course [README](../README.md) for preview, rendering, and publication commands.

# Copy the Textbook

- Open: https://www.jblearning.com/
- Print chapter in 3-pages chunks. Naming them `Pages xx-yy.pdf`.
- Combine into a single chapter PDF.


# Create Reading Comprehension Quiz Questions

- Start each class session with a reading comprehension quiz.
- Create a `quiz` subfolder`.
- Use this prompt: `/Users/bradcannell/Desktop/Git/knowledge-workbench/_ai/prompts/teaching/create-basic-reading-comprehension-questions.md`


# Add Reading Comprehension Quiz to Poll Everywhere

- Add the questions in `quiz.yml` to a CSV file that can be imported in Poll Everywhere.

```{python}
#| eval: false

script = script_root / "presentation_build_poll_everywhere_import.py"
quiz = Path("/Users/bradcannell/Desktop/Git/Academia/Teaching/aphs20203/Lecture Slides/Module 03 - Disease Occurrence Data/Disease Occurrence Data/quiz/quiz.yml")

subprocess.run([sys.executable, script, quiz], check=True)
```

- Open Poll Everywhere: https://www.polleverywhere.com/
- Create a new folder for the questions. The folder name should match the presentation name.
- Import the CSV file you created above.
- Add the response links to the `participation_url`in `quiz.yml`.


# Add Reading Comprehension Quiz Questions to the Presentation

- Add them immediately after the learning objectives.

```{python}
#| eval: false

python_executable = sys.executable
include_script = script_root / "presentation_generate_quiz_includes.py"
quiz = Path("/Users/bradcannell/Desktop/Git/Academia/Teaching/aphs20203/Lecture Slides/Module 03 - Disease Occurrence Data/Disease Occurrence Data/quiz/quiz.yml")

generated = subprocess.run(
    [
        python_executable,
        include_script,
        quiz,
        "--questions",
        "disease-data-linkage - disease-data-health-surveys",
        "--title-prefix",
        "Reading Comprehension Quiz",
        "--start-number",
        "1",
        "--include-feedback-notes"
    ],
    check=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)

subprocess.run(["pbcopy"], input=generated.stdout, check=True, text=True)
print("Copied the generated quiz includes to the clipboard.")
```
